title: Console: Optimize config version history timeline + compare view (diff + metadata + audit deep links)
creator: Dylan Brooks
body:
## Context
We’re adding immutable Optimize config version history + rollback. This ticket covers the Console UI surfaces for *viewing history* and *comparing versions*.

Target users:
- SRE/on-call: quickly identify last known-good version, understand what changed, jump to audit logs.
- Platform operator / customer admin: review changes (author + ticket link), confirm blast radius before rollback (rollback flow in ENG-4826).

## Scope (this ticket)
1) Version history timeline/table
- Add a new section in Console: **Optimize → Config → History** (entry point: route/model scope page).
- Show versions in reverse chronological order with pagination.
- Each row item includes:
  - version id (e.g., v17) and short hash
  - created timestamp
  - author (user display name; fallback to service principal name)
  - source (Console / API / Optimize recommendation) if available
  - reason / summary (free text)
  - linked ticket (Jira/Linear URL) if provided
  - status badge: Applied / Failed / Rolled back / Superseded (based on latest apply attempt in scope)
  - scope chips (customer, deployment mode, region/cluster, route, model)
- Provide filtering controls:
  - show only Applied
  - show only versions created by me
  - search by ticket URL or version id

2) Compare view (diff modal / page)
- Allow selecting any two versions from the history list:
  - default: compare selected version vs current active
  - alternate: compare any vs any
- Render diff with:
  - added/removed/changed sections with color and inline indicators
  - collapsible sections for large nested configs (batching/caching/quantization/routing)
  - “Copy diff as JSON Patch (preview)” button (best-effort; not a contractual API output)
  - “Copy full config JSON” for each side
- Important: handle redactions (if any fields are redacted by backend, show placeholder + tooltip “redacted”).

3) Audit log deep links
- For each version row, show:
  - “View audit events” deep link (opens Audit Log filtered by scope + version id + correlation id if available)
  - latest apply attempt outcome (success/failure) with link to the specific audit event

4) Permissions-aware UI
- Version history is readable for users with existing read access to the scope.
- Compare view should not leak data across scopes (no cross-tenant / cross-customer lookups).
- Actions (apply/rollback) are handled elsewhere, but this view should:
  - hide/disable “Rollback” affordance if user lacks `optimize.config.rollback` (ENG-4830)
  - show banner “You don’t have permission to rollback” rather than failing silently

## Non-goals
- Implement rollback button + confirmation + progress UI (ENG-4826).
- Implement preflight safe-apply wizard (ENG-4824/Phase 2).
- Server-side diff computation beyond what ENG-4822 provides.

## UX notes (from design)
- Keep the history list scannable. Default columns: Version, When, Author, Summary, Status, Links.
- “Blast radius” is *not* shown here yet (that lives in rollback confirmation), but we should show scope chips to avoid ambiguity.
- Compare should feel like “git diff for config”: stable ordering + collapsible groups.

Design references:
- Drive: `shared_drives/product/console-and-rollouts/rollback-ux-wire-notes.json` (history + compare notes)

## API assumptions
Depends on ENG-4822 providing:
- list versions (paginated)
- fetch version metadata + config payload
- diff payload generation OR both configs and we compute diff client-side

If API returns both config blobs, Console computes a stable-key diff locally with canonical ordering.

## Acceptance criteria
- History list loads for a scoped Optimize config (route/model/customer deployment scope) and paginates.
- Each history item shows author, timestamp, reason, and ticket link (when present).
- Clicking a version opens details with:
  - metadata
  - full JSON view
  - audit deep link
- Compare: selecting two versions renders a diff within 2 seconds for typical configs (<100KB each).
- Large configs degrade gracefully:
  - show “Diff too large to render inline” with option to download both JSON blobs.
- Audit deep links land in Audit Log view with correct filters applied (scope + version id).
- RBAC: rollback affordance is hidden/disabled for users without permission.

## Implementation plan
- Add new Console route + left-nav entry under Optimize config scope page.
- Build `VersionHistoryTable` component with column renderers + pagination controls.
- Build `VersionCompareModal`:
  - selection UI
  - diff renderer (use existing JSON diff component from routing policy compare if available; otherwise implement minimal diff with stable sorting)
- Add “Audit” link builder utility:
  - `/console/audit?resource=optimize_config&scope=...&version=...`
- Telemetry:
  - track events: `optimize_config_history_viewed`, `optimize_config_compare_opened`, `optimize_config_diff_copied`

## Risks / open questions
- Diff fidelity: if ordering in JSON isn’t stable, diffs become noisy. Mitigation: canonicalize key ordering client-side prior to diff.
- Redaction: confirm which fields can be redacted; ensure compare view doesn’t break when values are placeholders.
- Performance: diffing 2x 200KB configs in browser can be slow. Mitigation: cap inline rendering; add “download both JSON” fallback.

## Links
- Initiative: `PM-412-safe-apply-and-rollback-initiative`
- Related backend:
  - ENG-4822 (list/get/diff payloads)
  - ENG-4821 (schema + version store)
- Observability/audit:
  - ENG-4828 (metrics)
  - Confluence: `security-and-compliance/audit-logging/optimize-config-change-audit-events`
- Related PRs:
  - `sources/github/redwood/pr-10488-console-backend-version-history-endpoints.json` (needed for data)

## QA notes
- Validate with sample tenants:
  - Hosted sandbox (multiple versions with different authors)
  - Dedicated tenant with RBAC restrictions (no rollback permission)
- Test cases:
  - 0 versions (empty state: “No history yet; current config has not been versioned” should not occur post-backfill, but handle defensively)
  - 1 version (compare disabled)
  - 50+ versions (pagination + search)
  - diff for nested batching+cache toggles
  - audit deep link with correlation id present vs absent
comments: 2025-01-17 — Kenji Nakamura (Design): Posted updated wire notes. Requested: show ticket link as clickable + display hostname (jira/redwood linear) in UI for trust. Also asked for a clear empty state for “no versions”.

2025-01-21 — Chloe Martin: Backend endpoint shape is stabilizing. We’ll have `GET /optimize/config/versions` returning metadata + pointers. Full config fetch is separate endpoint; diff endpoint likely Phase 2, so assume client-side diff for now.
2025-01-23 — Felix Schneider: Started implementation behind `optimize_config_history_ui` flag. Reusing JSON viewer from routing policy page. Need a canonicalize step before diff to reduce churn.

2025-01-27 — Allison Grant: For audit deep links, please include `request_id` when available; otherwise version id + scope is fine. Also ensure links work in Private where audit view path differs (use relative route, not absolute hostname).
2025-01-30 — Dylan Brooks: Please make sure we don’t leak cross-scope data. Compare should only allow selecting versions within the same scope. No free-form version id input.
2025-02-04 — Felix Schneider: Added diff size cap (inline render up to 150KB total). Above that, show download buttons. Also added “copy full config” for both sides.
2025-02-07 — Rafael Mendes (On-call): UX request: include “Applied to: <cluster>” somewhere prominent. Scope chips are OK, but make sure region/cluster isn’t hidden behind overflow.

2025-02-11 — Felix Schneider: Marking done. History timeline + compare modal merged; audit deep links verified in staging. Follow-up filed for a minor styling issue with long ticket URLs wrapping poorly.
